    Publishers that deliver to the queue-triggered functions of the same service, without a broker: each message is handed to every function consuming the queue on a background thread, retried a few times if the function fails, and logged and dropped after that.

    Publishers that send to the Kafka topic named like the queue, which the queue-triggered functions consume when cloudhopper.events.broker=kafka.

    The ServiceLoader entry of the Spring Boot runtime: the publishers come from the Spring context, which registers its factory with Publishers.setFactory when it starts.
